summary: NOVONIX Ltd, an Australian foreign private issuer listed on ASX and quoted in the US, filed a Form 6-K furnishing an ASX Appendix 2A application to quote 74,694 new ordinary fully paid shares issued on the vesting and conversion of 106,175 employee performance rights on September 28, 2026. No cash consideration applies; shares rank equally with existing ordinary shares, and the holder is not key management. This is a routine equity-compensation administrative filing, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arb angle are implicated. Watch only for cumulative dilution from recurring employee scheme vestings.
